problems: All five dossiers validate with 0 errors and 0 warnings under --resolve (checked on the mount after install).

Cliopatria Qajar Dynasty 1895-1897 shape is a data error (Iran plus an Indonesian polygon); 1915-1921 shapes hand occupied Persian land to the Russian Empire, the British colonial empire and the Ottomans although Persia stayed sovereign; both corrected by verdicts and occupation events.

Cliopatria ends the Qajar row in 1923 and starts Pahlavi in 1924, but the pages end the Qajar state on 31 October 1925: new keyframe qajar-dynasty_1924 (1924-1925); the pahlavi-dynasty dossier should start in 1925 or 1926. Qajar to Pahlavi is a dynasty change on the same land: one colour family (persia).

Qajar occupation events name british-colonial-empire (the Cliopatria Name); british-empire and british-colonial-empire share Wikidata Q8680, so the counterpart string must follow whichever slug sa-06 and eu-11 settle on.

qatar-dynasty, qatar and state-of-qatar share Wikidata Q846 and are one continuous polity on the pages; this dossier is kept separate and ends in January 1872 where the ottoman-empire dossier takes the land. Colour agent should give the three one colour.

imamate-of-yemen and qasimids are the same Zaydi imamate in two Cliopatria rows (dossiers kept separate, linked predecessor/successor); the Ottoman dossier dates its Yemen gain 1873 against 1872 here.

Overlap with ottoman-empire is intended: it draws Egypt to 1810, the Hejaz and Najd in 1811-1833, and Qatar from 1873; the muhammad-ali-dynasty dossier records the Wahhabi War as a contest only to avoid a double claim on the Hejaz and Najd.

qatar-dynasty names house-of-khalifa as counterpart (found 1820 and the 1847-1851 contest); that dossier file was not yet on the mount when checked (the slug resolves through data/polities.csv, so --resolve shows no warning), and its owner should expect these events.
muhammad-ali-dynasty has no mirror gain for imamate-of-yemen 1833 Tihama loss; a gap-filler should add it from the Yemen Eyalet page.
